title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Managerial Accounting
description: This course provides tools and techniques to help managers plan, control, and evaluate business financial operations effectively.
longDescription: This course is about managerial accounting, which provides financial information to managers and decision-makers. It covers cost behaviour, cost-volume-profit analysis, budgeting, performance evaluation, and decision-making. The course also focuses on using technology in managerial accounting, including accounting software and data analytics tools. Students will gain hands-on experience using these tools to analyze financial data and make informed decisions. By the end of the course, students will have a solid understanding of the role of managerial accounting in organizational decision-making and the skills needed to analyze and interpret financial information.
courseDetails: Understand CVP Analysis. Understand Breakeven Point. Understand the Margin of Safety. Understand Operating Leverage. Understand Sales Mix. Understand Sales Mix and Break-even Analysis.
